sources.title: SDR - half-baked or well done?
sources.reading_scope: PDF pp.1-3: Introduction, sections 2.1-2.4 and visible section 3 examples; not a full-paper reading claim
locators: section 2.2 equal-power orthogonal signal/noise and uniform downscaling
section 2.3 equations 3-5, alpha and scale invariance
sources.adopted: Distinguish waveform/amplitude errors from scale-invariant shape diagnostics; use adversarial examples
sources.not_adopted: No speech separation model, learned waveform reconstruction, or direct SI-SDR reward

sources.title: On Over-fitting in Model Selection and Subsequent Selection Bias in Performance Evaluation
sources.reading_scope: PDF pp.1-2 (printed pp.2079-2080), abstract and introduction only; experiments and proofs not reviewed
locators: p2080: compare learning and model-selection procedures together; nested evaluation
sources.adopted: Thresholds, candidates and model selection belong in development, outside final test evaluation
sources.not_adopted: No claimed universal GPR thresholds or sample size; mother-model grouping is our experimental design
